support_team: IT service desk — add your approved contact

articles.title: VPN connection
steps: Confirm you are using the company-approved VPN client.
Record the error message without sharing credentials.
If the issue continues, contact the IT service desk.

articles.title: Printer unavailable
steps: Check the printer display for an error.
Confirm you selected the correct office printer.
Check whether a colleague can print.
If several people are affected, contact IT.

articles.title: Password or MFA problem
steps: Use your organisation's approved account recovery process.
Never share a password, recovery code or MFA code.
If recovery is unavailable, contact IT for identity verification.
Do not approve an MFA request you did not initiate.
